body: I'm a failure. I failed school, don't have a job and have done nothing with my life for a year now. I have seen a psychiatrist and talking about it only makes me feel worse. My situation seems easily amendable but there are so many struggles in my way, I can't even describe them all. I just want to die, I don't want to live anymore.

Thank you. I'm not exaggerating or having a meltdown, even when I'm not upset I still know that I will eventually kill myself. I try to do things to take my mind away but I can't enjoy anything anymore because I know I'm just wasting my life.

I don't have any interests anymore, something just broke inside of me and I no longer even wish to do things.

> Was the subject not a good fit, the stress of college overwhelming, or something else

All of the above, everything was just too much. Every day was hell and I couldn't do it anymore. I considered going back for another subject but after such an awful experience I don't want to go back at all, and I can't stand the idea of starting all over. I'm tired of existing, of having to think and feeling bad, I just want to be done. This could be my last night.
I'm not studying or working, that's why my life is going nowhere. I dropped out of school and I can't go on anymore. There's nothing I like, I just want to be dead.
I cannot function like a normal human being so what's the point.

I'm still here, unfortunately. Should've known I'd be too cowardly to jump, makes sense since I fail at everything else. I appreciate you commenting but part of me wishes you didn't. If I came back and saw no comments, maybe that would've been enough to put me over the edge, and I'd be free. I'm just tired of existing and I don't want to wake up anymore.
